Its strongest source-bound signals are the missing-Green frame, civilization, technology, artifice, progress, Yore-Tiller anchor boundary, and strict false-positive boundaries against generic artifacts, generic recursion, single-commander identity, adjacent-color drift, and color-code goodstuff.

allowed: Use Yore as source-grounded live identity language.

Use Manual fill required where exact card facts or public copy need stronger evidence.
not_allowed: Do not say Yore is an official MTG faction.

The user treats a single commander, support product, or name-adjacent phrase as enough to define Yore.
The user centers natural lifecycle, organic belonging, or Green-rooted continuity.
